card.fires_on: Short unit or abbreviation pieces right after a number, such as gm, in, mi, mp, or a fraction sign. Also some odd pieces inside names or words, like a Chinese character in a sutra title.

modes.label: Units after numbers

modes.description: A piece of a name or word where the text continues in a different style.
